stemMd: For f(x) = 1/x, which statement holds on the interval x > 0?
explanationMd: If 0 < a < b, multiplying 1/a > 1/b by positive ab gives b > a. Thus the reciprocal function decreases as positive input increases. It approaches zero for large input but never attains zero.

distractorRationale.a: Larger positive denominators give smaller reciprocals.
distractorRationale.d: Different positive inputs give different outputs.
distractorRationale.b: The reciprocal of a positive number is positive.
distractorRationale.e: Its value at one is one and it never equals zero.
